name: Kowalski
description: Browses your Instagram stories and feed and returns a markdown digest.

anthropicApiKey.description: Anthropic API key used for Claude calls (navigator, extractor, digest generator).

browserProfileDir.description: Path to the persistent Playwright user-data directory. Used by both the login flow (headful) and run flow (headless). Leading ~ is expanded to the user's home directory at plugin-register time.

scratchDir.description: Ephemeral per-run working directory (raw frames, extraction sidecars, session memory). Safe to wipe between runs. Leading ~ is expanded at plugin-register time.

outputDir.description: Durable output directory where finished analysis records land under analysis_records/<id>.json. Leading ~ is expanded at plugin-register time.

userName.description: User's name — surfaced to the agents as context when they personalize the digest.

location.description: User's location (city / region) — surfaced to the agents as context.
